reviews.title: Only care about the money
reviews.text: I used WW and lost a light weight, but I want something that I can continue doing without counting points. Also, I had a life- changing medical emergency in my family and they would not let me cancel my subscription. Before you sign up make sure you are 100% sure , because they will NOT let you cancel, even in the event of an emergency, and don’t have a heart to care about their customers. When it comes down to it, they only care about the money. I was very disappointed! Where’s the real support when you need it???

reviews.title: Would not recommend
reviews.text: I’ve done Weight Watchers in the past and loved the app. This new app is really hard to navigate. They lock you into a year subscription. READ THE FINE PRINT WHEN YOU SUBSCRIBE. I’ve wasted $12 a month for almost a year now. I’ve tried from time to time to use the app and end up frustrated. The diet plan doesn’t work for me…didn’t lose anything. I feel like they need to make an exception for unsatisfied customers and maybe have them pay a month or two after cancelling. Locking them in for a whole year when not using the app is not ok!

reviews.title: WW App

reviews.title: There are better apps but you’re stuck with this one
reviews.text: The developers of this app don’t seem to use this app. There are much better apps for tracking meals. This app delivers results in an extremely subpar manner. Unfortunately, this is the only app that works with WeightWatcher’s propriety point system. There are a ton of features, but they don’t really integrate well. There are multiple ways to do the same thing, but they don’t all work the same way. Plus, all the paths add a lot of clutter to the app. There’s a lot of swiping to get everyday things done because the layout isn’t very streamlined. And the search isn’t very smart. If I’m searching for a food that I have used in the past, it won’t always come up. The app prioritises things I’ve never eaten before. And there’s no oversight. I don’t ever want to see a food added by Joe in Manitoba because their addition isn’t vetted. There are a lot food items that have multiple entries with identical descriptions and serving sizes, but the points differ significantly. If it’s the same food in the same serving, it should be the same points. I really could go on and on about all the failures of this app, but I won’t. When my year is up, I’ll take what I learned from Weight Watchers and go somewhere else. I’ve used much better apps in the past, although I was trying to gain weight back then. If I could describe this app in one word it would be: Congestion. This app really is like trying to get between the 5 and the 605

reviews.title: New App is Frustrating
reviews.text: I really enjoyed the old weight watchers app and found it easy to use. The program definitely works if you follow it and it’s nice to get points back for exercising. However the new app is frustrating. You used to get a summary of each meal as soon as you clicked onto the app, now you have to click into that. I don’t like that the GLP-1 tab is one of the main tabs at the bottom that cannot be removed if you’re not using the injections, it’s annoying. I almost feel like I’m being advertised GLP-1 which isn’t what I’m interested in. I also found a lot of the features don’t work as well. I’m trying to edit a recipe and the app won’t let me save it - why?? Overall, I’m more frustrated than I was with the old version of the app and would consider not renewing because of it and trying a free calorie counting option.

reviews.title: Bring back precious version of app
reviews.text: Really dislike the new app (for context I’m on weight loss mode): too many buttons to press to get into anything, you have to hit various buttons just to track food (the main point for me), but also scrolling around and swiping here and there to log activities and weight, the points aren’t visible when tracking food, the old “connect” social media access feels hidden so I don’t engage much- this update feels like it’s for new users only and not for those of us who rely on it as tool. It is trying to do too much. Most importantly, I haven’t lost weight since it launched because it’s separately everything rather than keeping the main focus on the initial front screen. Separately, the “all in” language of “all in mode” excludes those of us fully committed to either weight loss or maintenance journeys. Not ok WW! Call it quick fix, blitz, or 4-week focus mode (which is what it is). And Please allow me the old app!

reviews.title: Confusing and hard to manoeuvre
reviews.text: I really don’t like this app at all! So much is counterintuitive because I have to click several different buttons to do basic things, then trying to get back to where I was or alter things is really tedious and frustrating. For example, I just added a meal but it saved to the wrong meal type. I go into the day, or the food item and there’s no way to simply change the meal type from lunch to breakfast. Other meal tracking apps allow you to add and remove or alter things so easily but this is such a pain! I’m constantly trying to find things and work out how to get to another area. Recently, I wanted to add a recipe…I could not work out how to do this and the AI instructions were useless and incorrect. I finally did it but to go to one sort, then press a plus key on the next part, then choose from a drip down menu on the next part…why is this so complicated?? Adding recipes is the most basic and essential thing to do! I’m getting to grips with it and still hate it. As a daily, (probably obsessive) user of my smartphone and hundreds of apps, this is a nightmare so I don’t need a standard response which assumes I’m incompetent, this is just an honest review from a well worn app user, who’s used meal trackers etc for years!

reviews.title: Senaste uppdateringen är sämst!
reviews.text:
Den senaste uppdateringen är så dålig och har så många buggar att man tappar andan. Är den en AI som byggt den? Testar ni ingenting alls? Gamla versionen tillbaka tack!

Några exempel (av många):
- Långsam uppstart med en massa bilder som fladdrar förbi
- Omöjligt att få en överblick över dagen
- Jättelätt att registrera mat på fel dag
- Många extraklick för saker som tidigare visades direkt, t.ex. dagens matlogg.
- GLP-1 läget är om möjligt ännu värre
— Den tar 30 sekunder att ladda. 
— Det är omöjligt att lägga till historiska injektioner. 
— Man ser inte när man tagit injektioner. 
— Öppnar man viktloggen på en iPad kan man inte gå tillbaka. Man måste force- stoppa appen

Och det här betalar man pengar för? Skulle jag leverera något så här dåligt skulle jag få sparken. Skärpning!

reviews.title: Not happy with changes to app
reviews.text:
I am very disappointed with the way that weight is now tracked in the new app - you have to click on stones to see the number of lbs and the lost is now calculated as a decimal fraction rather than listing the number of lbs lost. This means it is much harder to see small losses eg 0.5lb. Very disappointed. I want to revert to previous app but it won’t let me. I will be unsubscribing. Poor design of this section of the app and not helpful to your audience.

I appreciate the message sent in response to my review - recommending I look out for more changes as you update the app regularly. However, I would be reluctant to update the app again until I am sure that you have made the changes I suggested. Since I would not have updated the app last time if I had been aware of this backwards step change in recording weight.  Not sure what to do now!!!!!
